statements.status_notes: Waiting for upstream logstash to update cgi gem dependency to 0.3.7. CVE-2025-27220 affects cgi gem 0.3.6 requiring upgrade to 0.3.7. However, Ruby gems in the logstash image are managed by the upstream logstash Gradle build process using installDefaultGems, not directly controllable at the image definition level. The logstash build installs gems from the official logstash repository's gem specifications, making gem version overrides dependent on upstream logstash changes.
